resource: Level above which the Wheel opens
allocation_impact: No allocation; available points are max(0, level - 50) plus extra points (0 until their owners exist), one per level.
boundary_tests: max=50: level 50 is not eligible and has 0 points
max+1=51: level 51 is eligible with 1 point
notes: WHEEL-0 §6.1, §6.3 and §8; tests: character_wheel::tests::validation_applies_each_rule, an_ineligible_or_not_current_allocation_derives_zero. Registered by WHEEL-W1.
